title: CaliTweaks
description: An All-in-One bundle of crafting recipes that are Vanilla+ friendly and aren't overpowered! Perfect for Modpacks!
body:
A **Vanilla+ Datapack** made with Modpack integration in mind! Adding a series of recipes for Crafting, Smelting, and Blasting that are convenient but not too overpowered or intrusive! I intend to upkeep this datapack for as many versions of the game as I can!

As usual, recipe viewing mods such as JEI, EMI, or REI are suggested for the best results.
